subject: Retention escrow, SLA and attestation questions — Brightline SOC2/ISO
messages:
From: Alice McCarthy <alice.mccarthy@brightline.com>

Cc: security@brightline.com, Robert Halloran <robert.halloran@brightline.com>

Subject: Questions on retention escrow & deletion attestation for SOC2/ISO

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week. Our security team is putting together the SOC2/ISO evidence pack and had a couple of items we wanted to confirm about retention and deletion controls before we proceed to the formal attestation. High-level asks below — can you confirm the specific artifacts we should expect and approximate delivery timelines?

1) Proof of tenant-level deletion: sample audit logs showing a complete tenant deletion workflow (request -> job -> confirmation).
2) Retention escrow / immutable backup: description of where backups are stored, retention windows for backups vs primary data, and how we demonstrate logical isolation of Brightline backups.
3) SLA/commitment on deletion timelines for cross-region data (if a tenant elects erasure and had resources in us-east and eu-west).
4) SOP / runbook for deletion and retention escalation (who is notified, what manual checks exist).

We will need artifacts suitable for SOC2/ISO auditors (logs, runbooks, and a summary attestation letter). Please let us know who on your side will coordinate and the expected turnaround.

Best,
Alice
Security Operations
Brightline Capital

--
Alice McCarthy

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice McCarthy <alice.mccarthy@brightline.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Questions on retention escrow & deletion attestation for SOC2/ISO

Alice — thanks for the clear list. I'll coordinate internally and loop in Irene for the logs/runbook and Marissa for SLA/attestation. Initial answers below; will follow with artifacts by end of week.

Quick answers:
- Tenant deletion audit: we can provide redwood-deletion-job logs (timestamped events) plus a masked CSV sample showing job ids and status transitions.
- Backups: Brightline's backups are stored in encrypted object storage in the same region by default; we also offer an optional cross-region immutable backup escrow when requested. Retention windows: primary DB TTL is configurable per account (default 90 days), backups retained 90/180/365 days depending on plan — will provide the specific policy doc.
- Cross-region delete SLA: for hybrid cross-region tenants we have policy to cascade deletion within 7 days; we provide evidence of job completion per region.
- SOP: we have a deletion runbook versioned in the secure runbook repo; includes escalation matrix and manual verification checklist.

I'll send the artifacts and a draft attestation letter (Marissa will review) by Friday. If auditors need deeper raw logs we'll coordinate a time-limited secure share.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Retention escrow, SLA and attestation questions — Brightline SOC2/ISO

Hi all — attached are the artifacts requested for SOC2/ISO review. Summary below and pointers to the attachments.

Attachments (attached to this message):
- retention-sop_v3.pdf — retention & backup policy (includes per-plan retention windows and escrow option).
- deletion-audit-sample.csv — masked sample of tenant deletion job events (columns: job_id, tenant_alias, region, event, timestamp, outcome).
- redwood-dataflow-diagram.png — simplified diagram showing storage and backup topology per region.

Key points / clarifications:
1) Tenant deletion flow: delete request -> deletion service spawns jobs per region -> each job writes to deletion-audit stream -> final tombstone recorded. The CSV shows an example cascade where us-east completed at 2026-08-22T03:12:45Z and eu-west at 2026-08-24T01:02:13Z.
2) Backups & escrow: backups are encrypted with CMKs scoped to the customer tenant; escrow option provisions a dedicated escrow bucket per customer with object immutability enabled for the requested retention period. Escrow retention choices are 90/180/365 days; metadata manifests allow auditors to verify logical isolation.
3) Cross-region SLA: our documented process is to initiate cascade within 24 hours; practical completion depends on data volume — typical completion window is 3–7 days and we commit to providing region-level completion timestamps in the attestation.
4) Evidence readiness: deletion-audit-sample.csv is redacted for tenant ids; if auditors require raw event streams we can provide a time-limited, read-only AWS S3 presigned link and a signed evidence letter.

If this matches what you need, Marissa can produce the attestation letter and I can coordinate a secure artifact share.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
